<!-- One "- **Title**: description" line per change. The in-app updater shows each as a card. Update the marker above to the new versionName in every release PR. -->
- **🔄 No more endless "Syncing"**: If your sign-in needs refreshing, the app now waits and retries calmly instead of spinning non-stop.
- **👆 Tap the sync badge for details**: While it's syncing, a tap tells you what it's waiting for.
